# PrivacyScrubber
> A professional, browser-side metadata and EXIF purification tool.

## Purpose
Wipes hidden digital DNA (GPS, Device IDs, Timestamps) from photos before sharing.

## Key Features
- Zero-Server Processing: All scrubbing happens in the user's browser RAM.
- No-Logs Policy: No data is ever uploaded or stored.
- EXIF & XMP Purge: Removes over 140 types of metadata.

## Links
- App: https://privacyscrubber.vercel.app/
